code.team_name_taken: A team with that name already exists.
code.area_name_taken: An area with that name already exists.
code.project_key_taken: A project with that key already exists.
code.person_inactive: This person is no longer in the organization.
code.ticket_has_open_children: This ticket has open items. Finish or cancel the items before finishing it.
code.ticket_cycle: A ticket cannot be its own parent or the parent of one of its ancestors.
code.structure_busy: Another change to this project's structure is in progress. Try again in a moment.
code.concurrent_update: Another change happened at the same time. Try again.
code.server_busy: The server is busy. Try again in a moment.
code.project_archived: The project is archived and read-only.
code.assistant_not_configured: The assistant is not configured in this environment. Create the ticket manually.
code.assistant_unavailable: The assistant did not respond. Try again; if it keeps happening, create the ticket manually.
code.conversation_closed: This conversation has ended. Start a new conversation.
code.conversation_changed: The conversation changed while the assistant was replying. We are showing the latest version.
code.grouping_changed: One of these tickets has moved. Search again.
code.placement_stale: The place search no longer matches this draft. Searching again.
code.draft_required: The conversation does not have a draft yet. Ask the assistant to write one before continuing.
code.ticket_has_no_items: This ticket has no items yet.
code.github_unavailable: GitHub did not respond. Try again in a moment.
code.not_connected: The organization is not connected to GitHub.
code.installation_unavailable: The app installation on GitHub is not available.
code.repository_not_found: The app does not have access to this repository.
code.person_without_project_access: This person does not have access to the project yet. Grant a project role before assigning.
code.assistant_consent_required: AI is off for this organization. An administrator needs to turn it on in Settings. Create the ticket manually.
code.contribution_area_taken: The ticket already has a contribution from that area.
code.area_in_use: Tickets have a contribution from this area. Remove it from them before deleting the area.
code.ticket_in_idea: This ticket is part of an idea: its status can only change after the idea is accepted.
code.unknown_ticket_keys: The draft mentions tickets that do not exist: {{keys}}.
code.description_too_long: The description went over the limit together with the original request. Ask the assistant to shorten the parent ticket's description.
code.request_too_long: The original request went over the limit of a description. Split the request into smaller conversations.
code.chat_busy: A message of yours is already waiting for the assistant's reply in this chat. Wait for the reply, then send again.
code.chat_changed: The conversation changed on another device while the assistant was replying. We reloaded it; send the message again.
code.mention_not_allowed: Someone you marked cannot join this conversation (they cannot see what it is about, or are no longer in the organization). Remove that person and send again.
code.too_many_mentions: Mention at most 10 people per message.
code.thread_full: This thread already has the maximum of 25 participants.
code.chat_thread_rate_limited: You sent too many thread messages in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
code.chat_rate_limited: You sent too many messages to the assistant in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
code.invalid_cursor: Those messages could not be loaded. Reload the conversation.
code.participant_cannot_view_ticket: Someone in this conversation cannot see this ticket's project.
code.max_depth: This conversation is at the last level: you cannot open another thread inside it.
code.not_thread_owner: Only the person who opened the thread can include people in it.
code.principal_conversation: You cannot include people in the conversation with the assistant. Open a thread and include them there.
code.ticket_mismatch: This thread is already about another ticket.
code.not_principal: Only the conversation with the assistant can be cleared.

kind.unauthenticated: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
kind.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
kind.not_found: We couldn't find that item. It may have been removed.
kind.conflict: This change conflicts with the current state. Reload and try again.
kind.invalid: The data provided is not valid.
kind.server_error: The server ran into an error. Try again; if it keeps happening, let your administrator know.
kind.unavailable: The API is unavailable. Try again in a moment.

errors.removeTicketWithItems: This ticket has items. Move or remove the items before removing it.
